name: Camp Mayhem
source:
Welcome to Camp Mayview, where the counselors scheme and the kids are chaos incarnate. Will your cabin be award-winning angels, or hectic hellions?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Camp_Mayhem]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到梅维尤营地，这里的辅导员计划和孩子们都是混乱的化身。你的小屋会是屡获殊荣的天使，还是忙碌的恶棍？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Camp_Mayhem]Choices Wikia[/url]]
